title: German Pork Dumplings
description: A hearty German dish made with juicy pork and fluffy dumplings. Serve with a side of sauerkraut for a traditional meal.
instructions: 1. In a large pot of boiling salted water, cook dumplings until they float to the surface.
2. In a large skillet, cook pork over medium-high heat until browned.
3. Add chopped onion and caraway seeds (if using) to the skillet and cook until onion is translucent.
4. In a large bowl, combine flour, egg, and salt. Mix until a dough forms.
5. Divide dough into small pieces and shape into dumplings.
6. Add dumplings to the boiling water and cook until they float to the surface.
7. In the skillet, melt butter and stir in cooked pork and onion mixture.
8. Serve dumplings with the pork and onion mixture, and a side of sauerkraut.
